existing_endpoints: Preserve all five current destinations; no repurposing or event changes.

signing_secret.handling: Private supported UI transfer; never chat, logs, code, command arguments or files.
signing_secret.confirmation_required: At action time for creating the live webhook and placing its secret; exposure could forge webhook requests.

existing_credentials.stripe: stripe_api_secret (existing working production reference; validate required coupon/customer permissions before opening new checkout)
existing_credentials.sendgrid: sendgrid_api_key and sendgrid_from_email (existing working production references)

activation: Install closed backend first, configure/verify signed events and providers, complete staff bindings, then switch page/assets and open new checkout.
